name: Linen Table
description: A white-clothed table of olives and jasmine before billowing sheer curtains.
lighting: Bright diffuse backlight through sheer curtains, soft shallow focus
subject: either
prompt: A small table draped in crisp white linen fills the foreground, set close to a tall window where sheer white curtains billow inward on a breeze. On the cloth sit a small celadon ceramic vase holding a few sprigs of olive branch, a scatter of green olives and a loose spray of white jasmine. Bright diffuse morning light floods through the curtains from behind, turning the fabric luminous and wrapping every edge in a soft glow. The foreground leaves blur softly in a shallow depth of field, and the background dissolves into white light and moving gauze. The palette is white, pale sage, olive green and celadon, airy and calm.
